hazards.reason: The change rewrites product and rebuilds its indexes under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
hazards.subject: table/product/column/title

hazards.reason: Product.title changes from VARCHAR(80) to TEXT: servers built from the previous version still read and write VARCHAR(80).
hazards.subject: table/product/column/title

statements:
ALTER TABLE product
  DROP COLUMN search_text,
  ALTER COLUMN title TYPE TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN search_text TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(title, '')) STORED
steps.subject: table/product/column/title

recovery: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_product_search_trgm
statements: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_product_search_trgm ON product USING GIN (search_text gin_trgm_ops)
steps.subject: table/product/index/idx_product_search_trgm
